original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. Pool.apply verify : Pool.ContractState -> Pool.Call -> Option Pool.ContractState is a computable definition. It reads only its call and its state. The proof check is its parameter `verify`, not an axiom. For each call, an equation states it as `if h : Pre then some (Effect ⟨_, h⟩) else none`, in the form of ArmadaLean/Nitro/OpEquations.lean.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. At integrated cb9d5a91, the pool has only the inductive relation Step : PoolState -> PoolState -> Prop (ArmadaLean/Pool.lean line 1049). ArmadaLean declares no constant named Pool.apply.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Through /home/rix/bin/lean-run, run `lake env lean` on a file that holds `import ArmadaLean` and `#check @Pool.apply`; Lean prints an unknown-identifier error. `#print axioms` on a computable definition lists no axiom beyond propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. No approved statement changes: scripts/check.sh --json reports signatures_ok true. scripts/check.sh --json keeps every _ok field true against scripts/gate-baseline.json; a full run takes about 110 to 150 seconds on this host. No new axiom, sorry, admit, native_decide or #exit. No type-doctrine linter count rises above scripts/gate-baseline.json. When a count falls, scripts/update_gate_baseline.py rewrites the baseline in the same branch. No new file outside ArmadaLean/. A bare `lake clean` is never run. In docs/pool-executable.md, `Pool.Step` names the root-level inductive `Step` of ArmadaLean/Pool.lean.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) ArmadaLean pool model (ArmadaLean/Pool.lean and the modules that import it)
restatement: In the ArmadaLean Lean formalization, replace/augment the pool model so that `Pool.apply verify : Pool.ContractState -> Pool.Call -> Option Pool.ContractState` exists as a computable Lean definition (not an axiom) that reads only its `call` and `state` arguments, takes the cryptographic proof check as its `verify` parameter, and states each call's semantics in the exact equational form `if h : Pre then some (Effect ⟨_, h⟩) else none` as in ArmadaLean/Nitro/OpEquations.lean. The work leaves all currently-approved statements (including `Pool.Step` and docs/pool-executable.md's rules) unchanged, introducing no new axiom, `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, or `#exit`, not raising any type-doctrine linter count above scripts/gate-baseline.json, adding no new file outside ArmadaLean/, and never running a bare `lake clean`. scripts/check.sh --json must continue to report every `_ok` field (including `signatures_ok`) true against the baseline.

restatement_clauses.text: No approved statement changes: scripts/check.sh --json reports `signatures_ok` true. scripts/check.sh --json keeps every `_ok` field true against scripts/gate-baseline.json. No type-doctrine linter count rises above scripts/gate-baseline.json.

`Pool.apply verify : Pool.ContractState -> Pool.Call -> Option Pool.ContractState` exists as a computable Lean definition. `Pool.apply` reads only its `call` and `state` parameters (no other hidden inputs). The cryptographic proof check is passed in as the `verify` parameter, not introduced as an axiom. For each call, an equation states it in the exact form `if h : Pre then some (Effect ⟨_, h⟩) else none`, matching the style of ArmadaLean/Nitro/OpEquations.lean. No new axiom, `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, or `#exit` is introduced.

goal: Make the pool contract's step-by-step behavior computable as an actual function in the proof codebase (not just an abstract relation), stated call by call, all without weakening any of the project's existing safety checks or proof rules.
acceptance_criteria: Run `scripts/check.sh --json` from the repo root. It runs `lake build`, so it runs first and builds the tree that the Lean probe below reads. Every `_ok` field is true and the exit code is 0. A full run takes about 110 to 150 seconds on this host.

Run `python3 scripts/oracles/lean_probe.py scripts/oracles/pool_exec/PE3.lean` from the repo root, after the check above built the tree. Lean elaborates the committed probe of rule PE3 (docs/pool-executable.md) with no error, and prints `#print axioms` for `Pool.apply`, `Pool.apply_shield_equation`, `Pool.apply_transact_equation`, `Pool.apply_transactOwned_equation`. The probe fails when one of them depends on an axiom outside propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound and the declared primitives EdDSAVerify, VerifyAccepts and VerifyOwnedAccepts.
